sources.entry: SRECon Conferences - The Official SRE Conference.

summary.name: SREcon
summary.one_liner: SREcon is USENIX's conference series for site reliability engineering, with regional events held in the Americas, Europe/Middle East/Africa, and Asia/Pacific.
use_cases: Checking which SREcon events happen in a given region
Looking up past SREcon conference locations
Planning travel to an SRE conference
Browsing history of SREcon events from 2015 to 2028
summary.what_it_does: The page is a listing table of SREcon events by year, from 2015 to 2028. Each row gives the event name, region, dates, and city, such as SREcon28 Americas in Baltimore (June 2028) or SREcon26 Europe/Middle East/Africa in Dublin (October 2026). Events are grouped into Americas, Europe/Middle East/Africa, and Asia/Pacific tracks, and some years also list SREcon Conversations sessions. The listing covers dates and locations only; it does not describe talks, registration, or pricing.
notable: Official USENIX SREcon conference listing with regional tracks
Covers events from 2015 through scheduled 2028 dates
caveats: Page shows only a list of dates and locations; no details on talks, cost, or registration
Some past events have no listed city (e.g., SREcon21, SREcon20 Americas)
